annotations.title: Search events and markets by name

description: Use when finding event or market IDs by name. Best first. Use `event_path` for links and `title` for clean text. `headline` has highlights. Weak matches may retry with shorter full text. “Goes public” and “going public” also match IPO titles. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

limit.description: Max hits. total_events/total_markets count matches separately. _meta.total_capped flags a lower bound.

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

q.description: Event title or market question. Under 2 characters returns no hits.

name: search_suggest
title: Search events and markets by name
